bias.en: Uptrend, choppy · slipped under the 100-day, $433 held
bias.zh: 震荡上行 · 跌回 100 日均线下方，守住 $433

read.en: Rockwell Automation slipped 0.6% on Nov 4 to $443.88, trading between $432.82 and $448.67 on heavy volume. It is just above the rising 5-day ($443.6), 10-day ($438.1), 30-day ($436.2) and 200-day ($427.5) averages and just below the falling 100-day ($445.8). MACD has been above its signal since Oct 27 and above zero, histogram steady; Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Oct 27 ($423.62), and RSI is 55.
read.zh: 罗克韦尔自动化 11月4日下跌 0.6%，收于 $443.88，盘中区间 $432.82–448.67，成交量放大。股价略高于上行的 5 日（$443.6）、10 日（$438.1）、30 日（$436.2）和 200 日均线（$427.5），并略低于下行的 100 日均线（$445.8）。MACD 自 10月27日起位于信号线上方且在零轴之上，柱状图平稳；抛物线 SAR 自 10月27日起看多（$423.62），RSI 为 55。

read.en: The close slipped back under the 100-day and the Nov 3 low ($443.9), now resistance, while the dip to $432.8 held the Oct 30 low. Resistance is $445.8–448.7 (100-day, Nov 4 high), then $452.4–454.1 and $460. Support is $436.2–438.1 (30 and 10-day), then $432.8 (Oct 30 and Nov 4 lows) and $423.6–427.5. A close above $448.7 would target $452–454; below $432.8, $427.
